scope: Locomotion in Havenline Level 1 gameplay camera and actual paid-rescue first delivery. Optional tall art prototype on equivalent height and input. No overall game, store-release, phone performance or literal frame-identical advertising grade is implied.

compact_character_1.remaining: 19–32 mm of tread drift; heavy coat limits knee visibility at default camera. Start, accelerate, turn, stop and regular two-sided support were examined.

rescued_forester.remaining: Independent loaded-haul 60 fps camera shows brief projected overlap with the stationary player near the south gate. Finer boot detail is easier to see at zoom. The sustained near-ground drift is 4.5 mm.

taller_character_1.remaining: 29–50 mm of tread motion during the longest support patches; visibly raised/splayed arms and hands at the rear; prototype has 727,442 triangles; mobile performance unmeasured.

fidelity_limit: The original captured ads resolve movements and timing. Clothing, camera angle, obstructions and sampling prevent exact source joint-angle replication.
